features.decision: spread: veto when (ask − bid) ÷ mid at the entry quote > 10%
open interest: veto when the contract's OI published the morning of the entry session < 500
volume: veto when the contract's volume on the last completed session < 100
earnings: veto when a release falls between the last close before entry and the expiry's 16:00
macro: the same window for an FOMC decision, CPI or NFP
IV rank: veto when IV rank ≥ 0.80
entry cost share: keep the SPXW/SPY venue with the lower ((ask − mid) + fee ÷ 100) ÷ mid
term structure: keep the multi-day expiry bucket with the lowest at-the-money IV
implied vs realized: keep the expiry bucket with the lowest IM ÷ RM
distance: keep the strike bucket containing x_RM = RM ÷ IM
delta: keep the strike bucket whose contract's |delta| is nearest 0.30
UW GEX regime: G > 0 keep ATM, G < 0 keep OTM2
UW flip: price above the prior session's flip keep ATM, below keep OTM2
the implied move as the target
UW's walls (prior session) as targets
0DTE entries before 14:00 sold at the 14:00 bid
net premium since 09:30
sweep alerts: calls (ask − bid premium) − puts
NOPE of the last complete minute
market tide: net call − net put premium
dark pool: Σ premium × sign(price − NBBO mid), prints ≥ $1M
opening range: above ORH → call, below ORL → put (0DTE from 10:15)
prior-day structure: above the prior high → call, below the prior low → put
